headline: Star Wars A New Beginning Toy Pitch
post:

Now, original concept designs and prototypes from this unproduced line are available through Heritage Auctions. Would you like to add these rare items to your collection? 🌌✨

headline: Absolute Batman Face-to-Face With Joker
post:
Get ready for a massive shakeup in Gotham! According to Screen Rant, a brand-new comic book release completely redefines the history between Batman and his ultimate nemesis. In this dark alternate reality, Jack Grimm V actually orchestrated the tragedy that shaped Bruce Wayne, serving as the twisted mastermind behind his crusade.

During a tense face-to-face showdown in the villain's cave, readers learn a chilling truth about their rivalry. The issue features display cases holding armor from historical heroes who once tried to stop him. The antagonist reveals that these past challengers are the only ones capable of making him laugh! 🦇

What do you think of this terrifying new twist?

original_title: DC Reveals New Canon Joker Backstory That Changes Batman Forever

headline: Andy Weir on the biggest Star Wars problem
post:
"Project Hail Mary" author Andy Weir recently shared his thoughts on the state of "Star Wars" and how the franchise should move forward on the big screen.

According to Weir, a major issue is that when a monumental war ends and the good guys win, making a new monumental war can feel unsatisfying. Instead, he suggests telling smaller stories about other people during the Galactic Civil War, similar to "Rogue One."

Would you want to see more movies set during the Galactic Civil War?

#StarWars #AndyWeir #ProjectHailMary
original_title: The One Problem With Star Wars, According To Project Hail Mary Author Andy Weir [Exclusive]

headline: Green Lantern Lore: The 2004 Retcon
post:
According to Screen Rant, a major DC Comics retcon happened twenty-two years ago that fundamentally changed the Green Lantern mythos. In the 2004-2005 miniseries "Green Lantern: Rebirth," readers learned about an "emotional electromagnetic spectrum that can be harnessed and used," with green willpower standing out as the purest form.

This crucial reveal completely reframed Hal Jordan's past actions during the Emerald Twilight storyline. Instead of acting entirely on his own, Parallax was actually a physical manifestation of yellow fear energy that had influenced his behavior and later took control of him.

Following this massive shift, the DC Universe expanded with multiple color-coded corps tied to different emotions, ranging from the red rage of Atrocitus to the blue hope of the universe. Even heroes like Superman, Supergirl, and the Flash have temporarily wielded these various rings over the years. 🏮

Which emotional corps color is your absolute favorite?

#Entertainment #Hollywood #PopCulture
original_title: 22 Years Ago, Green Lantern Changed DC Lore Forever With The Best Retcon In Comic History

headline: Captain Marvel loses flight and power in Avengers
post:
Big changes are here for Earth's Mightiest Heroes in the new Avengers run from Chip Zdarsky and Marco Checchetto. Following a nuclear explosion, Carol Danvers has reportedly lost her ability to fly and is operating at ten percent of her usual power, even feeling physical pain now.

This massive nerf brings a brand-new level of tension to her fights, forcing Captain Marvel to rely on her military training instead of godlike strength. 

How do you feel about this major power downgrade for Carol Danvers? ⚡
